title: Workshop doors and loading bays
body: The repair workshop has rows of windows in its overhead doors. At the parcel hub, a dark rubber shelter wraps around the loading door and yellow strips mark its edges. The harbor warehouse has room for cargo doors that slide sideways along a track. Quartz Mart fits a metal roller shutter into its narrower receiving bay.
